question: How many tracks are in the database?
sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS total_tracks FROM Track;

question: Which country has the most customers?
sql: SELECT Country, COUNT(*) AS n FROM Customer GROUP BY Country ORDER BY n DESC LIMIT 1;

question: Which artist has the most albums?
sql: SELECT ar.Name, COUNT(*) AS album_count FROM Artist ar JOIN Album al ON al.ArtistId = ar.ArtistId GROUP BY ar.ArtistId ORDER BY album_count DESC LIMIT 1;

question: What are the top 3 countries by total revenue?
sql: SELECT c.Country, ROUND(SUM(i.Total), 2) AS revenue FROM Customer c JOIN Invoice i ON i.CustomerId = c.CustomerId GROUP BY c.Country ORDER BY revenue DESC LIMIT 3;

question: Which genre has the most tracks?
sql: SELECT g.Name, COUNT(*) AS track_count FROM Genre g JOIN Track t ON t.GenreId = g.GenreId GROUP BY g.GenreId ORDER BY track_count DESC LIMIT 1;

question: How many customers are there?
sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS total_customers FROM Customer;

question: How many customers are from Brazil?
sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS brazil_customers FROM Customer WHERE Country = 'Brazil';

question: What is the average invoice total, rounded to 2 decimal places?
sql: SELECT ROUND(AVG(Total), 2) AS avg_invoice_total FROM Invoice;

question: How many albums are in the database?
sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS total_albums FROM Album;

question: How many different countries do customers come from?
sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT Country) AS country_count FROM Customer;

question: What is the total revenue across all invoices, rounded to 2 decimal places?
sql: SELECT ROUND(SUM(Total), 2) AS total_revenue FROM Invoice;

question: How many employees work at the company?
sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS total_employees FROM Employee;

question: How many genres are there?
sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS total_genres FROM Genre;

question: What are the 5 genres with the most tracks, and how many tracks does each have?
sql: SELECT g.Name AS genre, COUNT(*) AS track_count FROM Genre g JOIN Track t ON t.GenreId = g.GenreId GROUP BY g.GenreId ORDER BY track_count DESC LIMIT 5;

question: Who are the 3 customers who have spent the most in total? Show their full names and totals rounded to 2 decimal places.
sql: SELECT c.FirstName || ' ' || c.LastName AS customer_name, ROUND(SUM(i.Total), 2) AS total_spent FROM Customer c JOIN Invoice i ON i.CustomerId = c.CustomerId GROUP BY c.CustomerId ORDER BY total_spent DESC LIMIT 3;

question: How many tracks are on the album titled 'Let There Be Rock'?
sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS track_count FROM Track t JOIN Album a ON a.AlbumId = t.AlbumId WHERE a.Title = 'Let There Be Rock';

question: Which album has the most tracks, and how many does it have?
sql: SELECT a.Title AS album, COUNT(*) AS track_count FROM Album a JOIN Track t ON t.AlbumId = a.AlbumId GROUP BY a.AlbumId ORDER BY track_count DESC LIMIT 1;

question: What was the total revenue in each year, rounded to 2 decimal places? List the years in order.
sql: SELECT strftime('%Y', InvoiceDate) AS year, ROUND(SUM(Total), 2) AS revenue FROM Invoice GROUP BY year ORDER BY year;

question: Which sales support agent is responsible for the most customers? Give their full name and the customer count.
sql: SELECT e.FirstName || ' ' || e.LastName AS agent, COUNT(*) AS customer_count FROM Employee e JOIN Customer c ON c.SupportRepId = e.EmployeeId GROUP BY e.EmployeeId ORDER BY customer_count DESC LIMIT 1;

question: Which media type has the most tracks, and how many?
sql: SELECT m.Name AS media_type, COUNT(*) AS track_count FROM MediaType m JOIN Track t ON t.MediaTypeId = m.MediaTypeId GROUP BY m.MediaTypeId ORDER BY track_count DESC LIMIT 1;

question: How many tracks are in the Rock genre?
sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS rock_tracks FROM Track t JOIN Genre g ON g.GenreId = t.GenreId WHERE g.Name = 'Rock';

question: What is the total revenue from customers in Germany, rounded to 2 decimal places?
sql: SELECT ROUND(SUM(i.Total), 2) AS germany_revenue FROM Invoice i JOIN Customer c ON c.CustomerId = i.CustomerId WHERE c.Country = 'Germany';

question: How many cities have at least 2 customers?
sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS city_count FROM (SELECT City FROM Customer GROUP BY City HAVING COUNT(*) >= 2);

question: How many invoices were issued in 2011?
sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS invoices_2011 FROM Invoice WHERE strftime('%Y', InvoiceDate) = '2011';

question: Which 3 artists have the most tracks in total, and how many tracks does each have?
sql: SELECT ar.Name AS artist, COUNT(*) AS track_count FROM Artist ar JOIN Album al ON al.ArtistId = ar.ArtistId JOIN Track t ON t.AlbumId = al.AlbumId GROUP BY ar.ArtistId ORDER BY track_count DESC LIMIT 3;

question: How many customers have bought tracks from at least 10 different genres?
sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS customer_count FROM (SELECT i.CustomerId FROM Invoice i JOIN InvoiceLine il ON il.InvoiceId = i.InvoiceId JOIN Track t ON t.TrackId = il.TrackId GROUP BY i.CustomerId HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT t.GenreId) >= 10);

question: Which artist has generated the most revenue from track sales, and how much? Round to 2 decimal places.
sql: SELECT ar.Name AS artist, ROUND(SUM(il.UnitPrice * il.Quantity), 2) AS revenue FROM InvoiceLine il JOIN Track t ON t.TrackId = il.TrackId JOIN Album al ON al.AlbumId = t.AlbumId JOIN Artist ar ON ar.ArtistId = al.ArtistId GROUP BY ar.ArtistId ORDER BY revenue DESC LIMIT 1;

question: Which genre has generated the most revenue from track sales, and how much? Round to 2 decimal places.
sql: SELECT g.Name AS genre, ROUND(SUM(il.UnitPrice * il.Quantity), 2) AS revenue FROM InvoiceLine il JOIN Track t ON t.TrackId = il.TrackId JOIN Genre g ON g.GenreId = t.GenreId GROUP BY g.GenreId ORDER BY revenue DESC LIMIT 1;

question: Which sales support agent's customers have generated the most invoice revenue? Give the agent's full name and the revenue rounded to 2 decimal places.
sql: SELECT e.FirstName || ' ' || e.LastName AS agent, ROUND(SUM(i.Total), 2) AS revenue FROM Employee e JOIN Customer c ON c.SupportRepId = e.EmployeeId JOIN Invoice i ON i.CustomerId = c.CustomerId GROUP BY e.EmployeeId ORDER BY revenue DESC LIMIT 1;

question: Among countries with at least 5 invoices, which has the highest average invoice total? Round the average to 2 decimal places.
sql: SELECT BillingCountry AS country, ROUND(AVG(Total), 2) AS avg_invoice FROM Invoice GROUP BY BillingCountry HAVING COUNT(*) >= 5 ORDER BY AVG(Total) DESC LIMIT 1;

question: What percentage of total invoice revenue came from customers in the USA? Round to 1 decimal place.
sql: SELECT ROUND(100.0 * (SELECT SUM(i.Total) FROM Invoice i JOIN Customer c ON c.CustomerId = i.CustomerId WHERE c.Country = 'USA') / (SELECT SUM(Total) FROM Invoice), 1) AS usa_percent;

question: How many customers have spent more in total than the average customer?
sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS above_average_customers FROM (SELECT CustomerId, SUM(Total) AS spent FROM Invoice GROUP BY CustomerId) WHERE spent > (SELECT AVG(spent) FROM (SELECT SUM(Total) AS spent FROM Invoice GROUP BY CustomerId));

question: What are the top 3 genres by number of tracks sold to customers in the USA, and how many units of each were sold?
sql: SELECT g.Name AS genre, SUM(il.Quantity) AS units_sold FROM InvoiceLine il JOIN Invoice i ON i.InvoiceId = il.InvoiceId JOIN Customer c ON c.CustomerId = i.CustomerId JOIN Track t ON t.TrackId = il.TrackId JOIN Genre g ON g.GenreId = t.GenreId WHERE c.Country = 'USA' GROUP BY g.GenreId ORDER BY units_sold DESC LIMIT 3;

question: Which album has generated the most revenue from track sales, and how much? Round to 2 decimal places.
sql: SELECT al.Title AS album, ROUND(SUM(il.UnitPrice * il.Quantity), 2) AS revenue FROM InvoiceLine il JOIN Track t ON t.TrackId = il.TrackId JOIN Album al ON al.AlbumId = t.AlbumId GROUP BY al.AlbumId ORDER BY revenue DESC LIMIT 1;

question: How many customers have purchased at least one Jazz track?
sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT i.CustomerId) AS rock_buyers FROM Invoice i JOIN InvoiceLine il ON il.InvoiceId = i.InvoiceId JOIN Track t ON t.TrackId = il.TrackId JOIN Genre g ON g.GenreId = t.GenreId WHERE g.Name = 'Jazz';
